planet.name: Planet Cyrene
planet.summary: A planet partner world built around faction story missions rather than open grinding. Progress runs on A.R.C. Faction Badges and Cyrene Mission Tokens earned from many 21-hour dailies, leading to long epic chains and the A.R.C. Prestige area. It still received content updates through Sept 2026.
planet.howToReach: Interplanetary teleport between planetary space stations using Teleportation Tokens (150 kg limit), or spaceship travel to Cyrene space. On the planet, start at the Rookie Training Area / A.R.C. Staging teleporters.
warnings: The official Cyrene forum (cyreneforum.com) shows a domain-parking page as of Nov 2026, and planetcyrene.com no longer serves a site. Cyrene release notes were read from Wayback copies and MindArk's own Steam release notes.
Many CyreneDream pages (missions, epics) were last edited in 2022-2024; numbers may have changed. Each activity flags this where it applies.
Support weapons have been an official known issue on Cyrene from 2025 through the Sept 2026 notes; healing-based objectives may not progress.
MindArk plans an Unreal Engine 5 client before Christmas 2026; maps, teleporters and waypoints may shift after it lands.
The Cyrene space-station arrival point could not be confirmed from a current source.

activities.title: Getting to Cyrene
activities.summary: Cyrene is a separate planet partner world. MindArk links all planetary space stations by token teleport, and older routes (ship travel through space) still exist. I could not confirm the exact name of Cyrene's arrival point from a current source.
steps: From another planet, use the space-station teleporter and pick Cyrene if it is in the destination list; this costs Teleportation Tokens and you must weigh 150 kg or less.
Buy or craft Teleportation Tokens first (auction, shops, or the blueprint at the Space Mining Terminal).
If no token route is offered, travel by spaceship (your own or a paid pilot) to Cyrene space and land.
Once on Cyrene, go to the Rookie Training Area or A.R.C. Staging teleporter to start the newcomer missions.

cost.text: Teleportation Tokens per trip (15 at launch in Jan 2025; players reported 10 per planet trip by Dec 2025/Jan 2026). Ship trips cost whatever the pilot charges.
cost.markupNote: Token prices vary on the market.

activities.limits: 150 kg weight limit for interplanetary teleports.

locations.label: Cyrene space station / landing point (not confirmed)

score.rationale: Needed once to reach the planet; token cost is modest but not free.

warnings: No current source names Cyrene's space-station destination; check the in-game teleporter list.
Token cost per trip changed after launch (15 -> 10 per player reports); 19.11.0 (Oct 2026) fixed some teleports not taking tokens, so expect the cost to apply.

activities.title: Unlock the Cyrene teleporter network
activities.summary: Cyrene has about 37 teleporters. Each one you touch is added to your network, which saves long runs later. The Hub is not a walkable place: you pick it from the drop-down on any teleporter.
steps: Start at the Rookie Training Area, A.R.C. Staging, A.R.C. Headquarters and 0x101 Supply Depot teleporters (all close together).
Pick up the mission-hub teleporters early: Atlas Hunting Grounds, Tans'Ta'Oh Outpost (A.R.C. faction mission NPCs), Zyn'Tukano Border, Kwarn and Rana Haven.
Add the rest as you hunt or mine; use waypoints to run between them.
Two teleport-ring shortcuts exist: one near Isle de Zel and one from near A.R.C. Immigration - Tanhok up to Robot Base Z.R.Q.

prereqInfo.note: You add a teleporter by reaching it, so you only need to be on Cyrene and able to get there. The Hub is chosen from any teleporter's drop-down (CyreneDream).
unknowns: Whether any teleporter on the list is locked behind a mission, faction rank or instance. No source checked says either way.

cost.text: Free apart from time and any travel risk.

score.rationale: Free and permanent; makes every later mission cheaper in time.

warnings: CyreneDream lists 36 teleporters and omits the Rookie Training Area TP that Entropia Nexus lists; Nexus also names one as 'Ngu Volcano Island Lookout Teleporter'.
MindArk is reworking the map/teleport UI ahead of the Unreal Engine 5 client (due before Christmas 2026); teleporter names may change.
The teleporter list rests on a fan page last edited June 2024 and an undated community database; no newer official list was found.

activities.title: A.R.C. Academy newcomer chain
activities.summary: Six short talk-and-learn missions at the Rookie Training Area. They hand out a free starter kit (pistol, knife, ammo, finder, extractor, probes, FAP, hat). Finishing all of them also counts toward A.R.C. Prestige later.
steps: Talk to Drill Instructor Selbor at the Rookie Training Area and read the info windows (Academy 01).
Academy 02: visit Weaponmasters Rob, Aron, Seigfried and Selbor in turn.
Academy 03: visit Miner Salazar; Academy 04: Medical Tech Godfrey; Academy 05: Fashion Advisor Robuck; return to Selbor each time.
Academy 06: kill the Junk Scout Bot nearby.
Optional: kill a Pleak with the trainee knife (Rob) and drop 1-3 probes with the trainee finder (Salazar).
rewards: Imperium Trainee Combat Knife (L) (1.50 PED TT)
Imperium Trainee Finder (L), Training Mineral Extractor (L), 10 Survey Probes
Achievement 'A.R.C. Academy!' (one of the A.R.C. Prestige entry checks)

prereqInfo.note: Entropia Nexus lists Academy 01 with no prerequisite and each later part needing the one before (01 to 06), with the two optional missions after 06. CyreneDream lists no requirement.
unknowns: Whether veteran avatars arriving on Cyrene get the same free kit as new ones.
Whether the 2023 reward list is still current.

cost.text: Free; the probes you drop come from the reward.

activities.limits: One-time per avatar. Since June 2025 Selbor also offers a repeatable trade for another trainee set (see cyrene-trainee-gear-repeat).

score.rationale: Free gear and a Prestige requirement for a few minutes of walking.

warnings: Steps and rewards come from a CyreneDream page last edited Dec 2023. Newer sources confirm the Academy still runs (Cyrene June 2025 notes on Selbor's trainee re-trade; CyreneDream's Feb 2026 Prestige page lists the 'A.R.C. Academy!' achievement) but do not re-list the rewards.

diagnostics.symptom: The optional knife or finder mission is not offered
diagnostics.check: Entropia Nexus shows both only after Academy 06 'Trial by fire!' is done. Finish 06 first.

unknowns: Whether the free kit's TT values changed since 2023.

activities.title: More Trainee Gear Please! (repeat trainee kit)
activities.summary: After the Academy, Selbor will swap 5 PED of Shrapnel for another trainee pistol, knife and ammo. Handy for TT-weapon missions such as Paneleon Hunter Jameson.
steps: Collect 5 PED of Shrapnel from loot.
Hand it to Drill Instructor Selbor.
rewards: Imperium Trainee Combat Knife (L) (1.50 PED TT)

cost.text: 5 PED of Shrapnel.

score.rationale: Small value; mainly a source of cheap TT-grade weapons.

activities.title: Starter one-off missions around A.R.C. HQ and Atlas
activities.summary: A cluster of small one-time missions near the starting area. Most need 5-20 low-level kills and pay one Imperium Armor Plating I; the envoy trips introduce A.R.C. HQ, the Hub and Zyn Immigration.
steps: Gathering Parts: kill 50 Junk Scout Bots for Drill Instructor Selbor (1 Cyrene Mission Token).
Envoy trips: talk to the A.R.C. Envoy then Private Yarl; the Turrelion Envoy then the Turrelion Greeter in the Hub; the Zyn'Kimbro Envoy then Colonel Jedidiah Jackson.

Armor plating missions: L.T. Locky (10 Weak Paneleon), Gardener Guy (15 mobs, mostly Tree Dragons), 'Scary' Hackfin (20 Hackfin), Private Harwell (15 Tree Dragons), Captain Doan (5 Imperium Scouts), Dr Nikolo (20 Young Empis Wasps), then Hollingsworth (20 Swamp Lurkers, needs Captain Doan's done).
rewards: Trophy items (Broken Scorpion, Confiscated Duster Slicer, Busted Zyn Mordincran)
requirementsText: 'Hollingsworth's other task!' needs Captain Doan's 'Help the Cap'n' done first (CyreneDream and Entropia Nexus).
'Gathering Parts': Entropia Nexus lists 'Trial By Fire' from the Drill Instructor as its prerequisite. Whether that is A.R.C. Academy 06 'Trial by fire!' is not confirmed.

prereqInfo.note: CyreneDream and Entropia Nexus list no requirement for most of these. Two do: Hollingsworth needs 'Help the Cap'n'; Nexus puts 'Gathering Parts' after a Drill Instructor mission 'Trial By Fire'.
unknowns: Whether Nexus' 'Trial By Fire' (end of a 'Cyrene New Arrival' chain: In The Shadows, Getting Battle Ready, Trial By Fire) is the same as Academy 06, and whether that chain still exists.
Whether the other one-offs have requirements no source lists.

cost.text: Ammo and decay for roughly 100 low-level kills in total.

score.rationale: Cheap, quick, and gives basic armor plates plus a tour of the hubs.

warnings: Rests on a CyreneDream page last edited Dec 2023 and the undated Entropia Nexus database; no newer source re-confirms these missions.

diagnostics.check: Finish Captain Doan's 'Help the Cap'n' (5 Imperium Scouts) first.

diagnostics.symptom: Drill Instructor Selbor doesn't offer 'Gathering Parts'
diagnostics.check: Entropia Nexus lists 'Trial By Fire' as its prerequisite. Finish the A.R.C. Academy chain (part 06 is 'Trial by fire!') and ask again. That this is the right mission is not confirmed.

unknowns: Which of these CyreneDream currently flags as broken (it marks some one-time missions as not working).

activities.title: A.R.C. Faction Stage 1 one-off missions (badge kick-start)
activities.summary: About 30 one-time kill missions given by the A.R.C. Faction Missions NPCs near Tans'Ta'Oh Outpost. Each pays 1-4 A.R.C. Faction Badges, the main Cyrene progression currency, so they are the fastest way toward the 200-badge Stage 2 threshold.
steps: Teleport to Tans'Ta'Oh Outpost and talk to the Low Level, Low Mid Level and High Mid Level faction NPCs.
Low level examples: 100 Pleak (1 badge), 75 Scout Bots (1), 95 Dire Weeds (2), 27 Tree Dragons (2), 70 Swamp Lurkers (2).
Mid level examples: 28 Zeladoth Alpha-Kappa (4), 19 Stalkers (4), 30 Dusters (4).
Higher examples: 8 Muckjaw, 8 Molten Golems, 7 Fenris, 4 Wiles (4 badges each).
rewards: 1-4 A.R.C. Faction Badges per mission (roughly 70+ badges if all are done)

cost.text: Ammo/decay; harder targets need mid-level gear.

currencies.name: A.R.C. Faction Badge
currencies.note: Keep them: many unlocks check the badges you carry.

activities.title: Tempo trials (Puny and Zyn'Nix)
activities.summary: Timed hunting dailies. Puny trials ask for 10-30 small creatures in 15 minutes for a tiny skill reward; Zyn'Nix trials ask for 10-30 mid-level creatures in 25 minutes for about ten times more skill.
steps: Grab the Puny trials from the tempo managers near the starting area: Pleak, Crystal Pede, Junk Bot, Tree Dragon, Dire Weed.
Kill the required count before the 15-minute timer ends.
Later add Zyn'Nix tempos: Old Tide Claws, Adult Horned Birds, Duster Workers, Guardian Dire Plants, Mature Sky Wraiths (25 minutes).
rewards: Puny: about 0.01 PED of a combat skill each
Zyn'Nix: about 0.1 PED of a combat skill each

prereqInfo.note: CyreneDream (Feb 2026) and Entropia Nexus list no requirement; you start each trial at its Tempo Manager.
unknowns: No source says outright that the trials need nothing first.

cost.text: Ammo/decay for 10-30 kills per trial.

cooldown.resetNote: CyreneDream lists 21 hours for every tempo trial.

score.rationale: Low reward but cheap, quick skill drip for newcomers.

warnings: The Oct 2025 VU moved the Crystal Pede Tempo Manager away from the water and restored map markers back to tempo givers; older waypoints for that NPC may be off.
Rests on fan sources only (CyreneDream, Entropia Codex, Entropia Nexus); no official list.

activities.title: A.R.C. Faction Stage 1 dailies and 'Meet the...' dailies
activities.summary: Repeatable kill missions that each pay 1 A.R.C. Faction Badge, plus three 'Meet the...' kill-point dailies that pay small skill rewards.
steps: Badge dailies: 5 Devastator Sea Wraiths, 12 Mutated Dire Weeds, 8 Old Paneleon, 110 Scout Bot Collector XT, or 35 Swamp Lurkers (1 badge each).
Skill dailies: 200 kill points of Merfolken (Tanhok), Dusters (Turrelions) or Paneleon (Zyn'Kimbro).
Duvall's dailies: 150 kill points of Stalker Bots or Living Vortex for a choice of skill.
rewards: 1 A.R.C. Faction Badge per Stage 1 daily
About 0.2 PED skill per 'Meet the...' daily; 0.14-0.58 PED for Duvall's

prereqInfo.note: Neither CyreneDream (Feb 2026) nor Entropia Nexus lists a requirement for these dailies, although CyreneDream does list them for other missions (for example Stage 2 needs 200 badges on you).
unknowns: No source says outright that these need nothing first (for example the A.R.C. Academy or the Stage 1 one-time missions).

cost.text: Ammo/decay; Scout Bot Collector XT is the newcomer-friendly badge daily.

cooldown.resetNote: CyreneDream and Entropia Nexus list 21 hours; Nexus says the timer starts when you complete the mission.

locations.label: Waypoints per mission on the CyreneDream Repeatable Missions page

warnings: Rests on fan sources only (CyreneDream, Entropia Codex, Entropia Nexus); no official list.

activities.title: Cyrene Mission Token turn-in and hunting dailies
activities.summary: A set of dailies that pay Cyrene Mission Tokens, used for token vendors, some crafting recipes and the Prestige keycard. Most just ask you to hand in common ores, crystals or crafted parts.
steps: Turn-ins (21h): 5 Yellow Crystals (1 token), 5 Zorn Star Ore (1), 1 Light Power Cell (1), 3 Blue Crystals (1), 5 Green Crystals (3), 5 Zorn Star Ingots (3), 5 Scrap Metal (4), 5 Kaisenite Ingots (6).
48h tributes: 20 Bonding Liquid or 40 Zorn Star Ore (8 tokens each).
Hunting: Pict's Pollen Issue, 20 Mutated Dire Weeds (8 tokens, 21h); Getting Slimed!, 20 Bile Jellyworms (2 tokens); The Chief's Request, 100 Zyn'Dos (40 tokens, 4-day cooldown).
Auraforging for 'Axe': collect 500 sweat from nearby Paneleon (1-3 tokens).
rewards: 1-8 Cyrene Mission Tokens per mission; 40 from The Chief's Request
requirementsText: Auraforging daily: stay in the Weak Paneleon area near NPC Axe while you gather the sweat (Entropia Codex).

prereqInfo.note: CyreneDream (Feb 2026) and Entropia Nexus list no requirement for these turn-ins and hunts. For the Auraforging sweat daily, Nexus also lists a one-time 'Find the Auraforger' (visit Sweat Acolyte Zep'zen, then the Auraforger).
unknowns: Whether 'Find the Auraforger' must be done before the Auraforging daily.
No source says outright that the other dailies need nothing first.

cost.text: You give up the TT value (and any markup) of the handed-in materials.
cost.markupNote: Ores and crystals handed in have small markup; check the auction before using bought materials.

currencies.name: Cyrene Mission Token
currencies.note: Kept for vendors, crafting (e.g. Imperium Key Cube) and the Prestige keycard.

cooldown.resetNote: Most are 21 hours; the two tributes are 48 hours and The Chief's Request is 4 days (per CyreneDream).

locations.label: NPC waypoints per mission on the CyreneDream Repeatable Missions page

score.rationale: Tokens are needed for Prestige (1000) and vendors; inputs are cheap.

warnings: Entropia Codex gives 24 hours for the Auraforging daily; Entropia Nexus gives 21 hours and CyreneDream does not list it.
Rests on fan sources only (CyreneDream, Entropia Codex, Entropia Nexus); no official list.

activities.title: Mining dailies (Mine Up and Stage 2 mining)
activities.summary: Five 'Mine Up' dailies pay small mining skill for finding a single claim of a set resource. With 200 badges on you, five Stage 2 mining dailies each add 1 badge.
steps: Mine Up: find one claim of Iridium (0.6 PED+), Kaisenite (0.4+), Yellow Crystal (0.2+), Zorn Star Ore (0.2+) or Blue Crystal (0.4+).
With 200+ badges in inventory, take Stage 2 Mining #1-#5: find 3 deposits (0.1 PED+) of Zorn Star, Yellow Crystal, Kaisenite, Green Crystal or Blue Crystal.
Hand found materials to the token turn-in dailies to stack value.
rewards: 0.04-0.1 PED of a mining skill per Mine Up daily
1 A.R.C. Faction Badge per Stage 2 mining daily (5 per day)
requirementsText: 200 A.R.C. Faction Badges in inventory for the Stage 2 mining dailies

cost.text: Probe and finder/extractor decay.

cooldown.resetNote: CyreneDream lists 21 hours for all of these.

locations.label: Mission NPC waypoints on the CyreneDream Repeatable Missions page (Entropia Codex says Will Andrews and Leigh near A.R.C. Staging)

score.rationale: Five badges a day for cheap mining once at 200 badges.

activities.title: Sweat dailies and the Paneleon TT-weapon mission
activities.summary: Cheap dailies for sweaters: 500 sweat buys a badge, and Paneleon Hunter Jameson pays ammo for killing Paneleon with TT weapons.
steps: Sweat Weak Paneleon (popular spot near the start) for at least 1000 bottles.
Get Sweaty!: turn in 500 sweat to Andrina (Sweat Collections) for 1 badge.
Paneleon Hunter Jameson: kill 18 Paneleon with Trade Terminal weapons for 1.5 PED of Universal Ammo.
Optional: join the player-run daily SSI sweat event (Mon-Fri 20:00, Sat/Sun 15:00 UTC per CyreneDream).

cost.text: Mindforce chip decay is negligible; TT weapons for Jameson come from the Academy.

cooldown.resetNote: CyreneDream's mission list says 21 hours; its Sweating page says 24 hours for Jameson.

score.rationale: Near-free badge and ammo every day.

warnings: Jameson's cooldown is 21h on one CyreneDream page and 24h on another; treated as 21h here.
The SSI event is player-run and may lapse without notice.

activities.title: Arms Merchant: Ozpyn BPX/LPX starter guns
activities.summary: Private 'Snow' Landon trades residue from hunting near the rookie area for an Ozpyn laser or BLP gun. Entropia Codex recommends the P3 version.
steps: Hunt around the Rookie Training Area and keep Robot Component Residue and Animal Oil Residue.
Trade 5 PED of Robot Component Residue for an Ozpyn BPX-P1 or LPX-P1, or 9 PED of Animal Oil Residue for a BPX-P3 or LPX-P3.
rewards: Ozpyn BPX-P1 / LPX-P1, or BPX-P3 / LPX-P3

cost.text: 5-9 PED of residue (TT value) per gun.
cost.markupNote: Residue has little markup, so the cost is mostly TT.

score.rationale: Cheap upgrade from trainee weapons for new hunters.

activities.title: Imperium Ranger hunts (group badge dailies)
activities.summary: Shared-loot bosses at six spots. Anyone who deals damage (or heals someone who does) while holding the mission gets 3, 6 or 10 badges, once per 24 hours per spot. Players call spawns in chat.
steps: Join the #Cyrene_Rangers channel (ask the channel owner for an invite) and watch #Cyrene.
When a spawn is called, travel to it and enter the area to receive the mission (leave and re-enter if it does not appear).
Wait for the caller to say go, then do at least 1 damage or heal a shooter.
Tier 1 (level 44, 5000 HP) at Atlas and Rana: 3 badges; Tier 2 (level 50) at Desert and Z.R.Q.: 6; Tier 3 (level 56) at Island Biome and Isle de Zel: 10.

cost.text: A few shots plus travel; bring armor for level 44-56 hits.

currencies.name: A.R.C. Faction Badge
currencies.note: Up to 38 per day across all six.

cooldown.resetNote: 24 hours per ranger location, counted from your own kill (CyreneDream). Rangers respawn roughly every 4-6 hours.

score.rationale: Up to 38 badges a day for minimal ammo; the single best badge source.

warnings: Support weapons have been listed as not working properly on Cyrene in every official note from 2025 through Sept 2026; heal with a regular FAP if you go the healer route.
The ranger chat channel has been switched between public and private in the past.

activities.title: Crafting and taming dailies
activities.summary: Five crafting dailies pay a badge plus a little crafting skill for one successful craft of a cheap item. Pet Master dailies pay Animal Taming or Zoology skill.
steps: Craft one C.B.R. 107, Embossed Cyrene Shirt, Cube Empowered Lube, Cyrene Acid Armor Plate or Cube Enhanced Metal (each 1 badge + skill).
Skill-only crafting dailies: Ozpyn Filter, Enkidd Dire S1 (L), Patterned Shirt Series 1, Ozpyn Cold Protector (L), Imperium Key Cube.
Taming: tame 35 Arret or 40 Weak Paneleon (low) or 10 Puny Mang Chang/Rhino Beetle (mid); turn-in dailies take tamed pets.
rewards: 1 badge + 0.04-0.06 PED crafting skill per badge crafting daily

cost.text: Materials for one successful craft each (failures cost extra).

currencies.name: Cyrene Mission Token
currencies.note: Some recipes (e.g. Imperium Key Cube) use tokens as an ingredient.

score.rationale: Five extra badges a day for cheap crafts.

activities.title: Texture blueprint dailies (Kayde, Hoban, Ben, Jyor'den)
activities.summary: Daily missions that pay clicks on limited texture blueprints. The planet team adds new texture rewards to these almost every VU (2025-2026), and Sept 2026 added a Texture Pattern Matching daily.
steps: Kayde Barnes (needs 300 badges): attempt 100 Synthetic Leather Texture crafts for 20 clicks of a chosen (L) texture blueprint.
Hoban Statsk: hand in 50 badges and 10 Robotics Enhancing Gel for 20 clicks of a Molten texture blueprint.
Ben Keery: trade 15 Rare Pleak Wings and 15 Animal Oil Residue for 10 clicks of a Polka-dot texture blueprint.
Texture Tutor Jyor'den in Zyn'Tukano: new daily crafting mission for Texture Pattern Matching (added Sept 2026).
rewards: Limited texture blueprint clicks (seasonal designs added each VU)
requirementsText: 300 A.R.C. Faction Badges in inventory for Kayde's mission

cost.text: Crafting materials; Hoban's version also costs 50 badges.
cost.markupNote: Texture BP clicks can sell for markup; not guaranteed.

cooldown.resetNote: CyreneDream lists 24 hours for Kayde, Hoban and Ben.

score.rationale: Steady crafting content; value depends on texture demand.

activities.title: Mazeweaver dailies and the Wolpertinger pet
activities.summary: A maze area with several daily certificate missions. You need a Maze Hammer (bought with Shrapnel and refundable). 200 certificates buy a Wolpertinger pet.
steps: Trade 50,000 Shrapnel (5 PED) to Mazeweaver Ricky for an account-bound Maze Hammer.
Each day: talk to Rayen, then do Maze Blitz (10 Vlanwings with the hammer), Fix the Burrow, the Missing Soul/Tool finds, Vlad the Unraveler and the Rat Race (up to 3 certificates for gold time).
Hand 200 Mazeweaver Certificates to Mazeweaver Reggie for the pet.
Return a fully repaired hammer to Ricardo to get the 50,000 Shrapnel back.

cost.text: 50,000 Shrapnel for the hammer (refundable when returned fully repaired) plus hammer decay.

cooldown.resetNote: CyreneDream lists 21 hours for the maze dailies.

score.rationale: Cheap long-term pet goal; about 6-8 certificates a day means roughly a month.

warnings: CyreneDream page last edited over 18 months ago; not re-confirmed by a newer source.

activities.title: Weekly missions (Doctor Bylar, Lumberjack, Drill Bots)
activities.summary: Seven-day missions with bigger kill or gathering goals that pay boosters, creature control capsules or limited blueprints.
steps: Doctor Bylar (four variants): collect samples from set creatures for Neurobiotic Boosters or Creature Control Capsules (Paneleon, Zeladoth).
You're a Lumberjack now: harvest 10,000 Moonleaf Boards for 20 clicks of a random decoration/tool blueprint.
Drill into the system: 5500 Drill Bot kill points for an Adventurer's Finder (L) blueprint.
Cages to Pills: turn in caged pets for creature control capsules.

cost.text: Many hundreds of kills for the Bylar variants.

score.rationale: Useful items but big kill counts.

activities.title: A.R.C. ranks and badge-gated content
activities.summary: Most Cyrene content checks how many A.R.C. Faction Badges you are carrying. Holding 200, 500 and 1200 badges gives A.R.C. ranks 1-3 (missions in the Hub) and unlocks better dailies, buffs and the faction terminals.
steps: Keep badges in inventory; do not spend below a threshold you rely on.
200 badges: Stage 2 dailies, A.R.C. Summoner, Hub faction terminal stage 1, Rank 1 mission in the Hub.
300: Kayde Barnes texture daily and Tanhok decorator weekly. 500: Rana Haven buffs, Rank 2 (A.R.C. Lancer (L) blueprint).
1200: Rank 3 'A.R.C. Commander' achievement (a Prestige requirement). 1500: Robot Base Z.R.Q. buffs.
rewards: Access to higher dailies and terminals

cost.text: No direct cost; badges are checked, not consumed, for ranks.

locations.label: Rank missions are inside The Hub (pick 'The Hub' from any teleporter)

score.rationale: Core Cyrene progression; takes weeks of dailies.

warnings: Entropia Central says the faction vendors are paid only in badges; CyreneDream shows the Hub terminals take Shrapnel and Limited Weapon Cubes while badges are only checked. CyreneDream (more detailed) is used here.

activities.title: Rana Haven and Robot Base Z.R.Q. buff missions
activities.summary: Exploration missions that give short hunting buffs. Rana Haven (500 badges) gives 1% buffs for 1 hour; Robot Base Z.R.Q. (1500 badges) gives 2% buffs for 2 hours.
steps: Rana Haven: enter the cave, take a delegate's mission, check three A.R.C. toxicity testers, return to Consule Laekces.
Buffs: +1 point crit chance, +1% reload, +1% crit damage, +1% max health, +1% damage (1 hour each).
Z.R.Q.: take the teleport rings up to Tanhok Warleader Kyzrin; find spears, climb the satellite tower, collect weapons, find unstable elements or deliver info to the tree.
Z.R.Q. buffs are 2% for 2 hours and are lost on death or logout.
rewards: Temporary hunting buffs (1% for 1h at Rana; 2% for 2h at Z.R.Q.)

cost.text: Time only.

cooldown.resetNote: CyreneDream files these under 'Daily Buff Missions' but gives no exact timer.

score.rationale: Free small buffs; best used right before a big hunt.

warnings: Rana Haven page last edited Dec 2023.

activities.title: A.R.C. Limited Weapon Cubes and Ecotron (L) guns
activities.summary: A.R.C. weapon vouchers drop from certain creatures. Refined with Zorn Star Ingots they become Limited Weapon Cubes, which pay for Ecotron (L) weapons at the A.R.C. faction terminals in the Hub (Tier 4 now in Prestige).
steps: Loot an A.R.C. Tier 1 Limited Weapon Voucher (Generation I 5P1D3R, Nimet).
Refine it with 5000 Zorn Star Ingots (150 PED): you get a Tier 1 Limited Weapon Cube (105.01 PED TT) and 1500 ingots back.
With the cube and 200 badges on you, go to the Hub, take the A.R.C. Faction Stage 1 teleporter and buy the Ecotron v.15e at the terminal.
Higher tiers follow the same idea; Tier 4 vouchers (from r00t / Flesh Ripper) are turned in inside A.R.C. Prestige.
rewards: Ecotron (L) weapon of the matching tier

cost.text: About 105 PED of ingots end up in the cube (150 in, 45 back); weapon TT comes from the cube.
cost.markupNote: Since Mar 2026 cubes can also be sold to the trade terminal.

locations.label: Hub A.R.C. Faction Stage 1 terminal (Hub waypoints do not copy correctly per CyreneDream)

score.rationale: Strong planet-specific weapons, but needs a voucher drop and ingots.

warnings: Tier 1 voucher page last edited Jan 2024; ingot amounts for higher tiers not confirmed here.

activities.title: The Hub (separate PvP-focused zone)
activities.summary: The Hub is a separate area chosen from any teleporter's drop-down. It removes everything you carry on entry (implants included) and has its own token economy: Pit Turrelia Lurkers drop Lime Green Tokens, and Hub vendors sell Hub-only gear.
steps: Bank or note anything important first: the Hub strips all items, and implants may need a relog to reappear afterwards.
Do the 'Go check out the Hub' envoy mission and your A.R.C. rank missions there.
Farm Pit Turrelia Lurkers (150 HP) for Lime Green Tokens and Shrapnel; a 500 HP Beast spawns every 2 hours.
rewards: Lime Green Tokens / Hub reward tokens for Hub vendors

cost.text: Nothing to bring; Hub weapons come from Hub tokens.

currencies.name: Lime Green Tokens
currencies.note: Hub currency; 550,000 buy the Coat of the Proving Grounds.

score.rationale: Needed for ranks and the Assassinator chain; quirky rules.

warnings: Oct 2026 (19.11.0) fixed implant buffs staying active after the Hub removed the implant.

activities.title: Refurbished H.E.A.R.T. FAP chain (Gear Up: New Fap)
activities.summary: A 13-stage chain that builds and upgrades a planet-made healing tool from Rank I to Rank X. Early stages are cheap kills of starter creatures; Stage 10 is a Prestige requirement.
steps: Talk to Medical Tech Orandius (near the 0x101 Supply Depot teleporter).
Stages 1-2: turn in 200 Bone and 75 Bone-In Meat. Stages 3-8: 250 kills each of Weak Paneleon, Young Crystal Pede, Duster Scapegoats, Puny Nimet, Breezy and Gale Living Vortex (Ranks I-VI).
Stage 9 (can be done later): 300 Basic Skyshatter Drones plus 500 Lesser Claw and 2000 Animal Oil Residue (Vigorous/Speedy VI).
Stages 10-13 (Ranks VII-X): big kill, crafting and turn-in goals with other NPCs (Caleb, Kandake, Jones, Lazarus). Each upgrade needs the previous FAP repaired and handed in.
rewards: Refurbished H.E.A.R.T. Rank I to X (Vigorous/Speedy variants)
Completion 'Gear Up: New Fap - Stage 10' counts for Prestige
requirementsText: For each rank upgrade: the previous H.E.A.R.T. repaired and handed in (CyreneDream).

prereqInfo.note: CyreneDream: talk to Medical Tech Orandius to start; each new rank needs the previous FAP repaired and handed in. The Rank X work starts with Lazarus at the 0x101 Supply Depot (Cyrene June 2025 notes). Nexus lists no prerequisite for Stage 1.
unknowns: Whether Stage 1 needs anything before you talk to Orandius. No source says.

cost.text: Kills and turn-ins; later stages need large residue amounts and full repairs (Rank IX repair about 80 PED TT, 6 times, per CyreneDream).

score.rationale: Cheap start with a useful tool; full chain is a long-term goal.

warnings: Stage 13 needs healing players with H.E.A.R.T. IX; support-weapon issues were listed as a known Cyrene platform issue through Sept 2026.

diagnostics.check: Repair the previous rank fully and carry it so you can hand it in; CyreneDream says each upgrade needs that.

activities.title: Zyn'Tukano Psyche Master (sweat ladder)
activities.summary: Four sweat ranks with Zyn Psyche Master Aten'ten. Each rank asks you to sweat creatures yourself and then donate a larger amount. Rank 4 is a Prestige requirement and unlocks Zyn'viathan part 4.
steps: Rank 1: collect 5,000 sweat, donate 10,000 (about 0.98 PED Sweat Gatherer).
Rank 2: collect 10,000, donate 20,000 (about 2 PED). Rank 3: 20,000 / 40,000 (about 4 PED).
Rank 4: collect 40,000, donate 80,000 for a voucher for a Synchronization Chip 1 (L) from the Zyn / A.R.C. Trader.
Side trade offers with Zyn Collector Oro'nobo (3-day cooldown) and two Zyn Summoner dailies.
rewards: Sweat Gatherer skill (about 7 PED over ranks 1-3)

cost.text: 150,000 sweat donated in total (sweat can also be bought).

score.rationale: Almost free if you sweat yourself, but very long.

warnings: Psyche Master page last edited Jan 2023; rewards not re-confirmed.

activities.title: Challenger Esther 1000-kill blueprint missions
activities.summary: Five one-time challenges at A.R.C. HQ: 1000 kills of one species each, each paying a limited blueprint. All five completions are Prestige requirements.
steps: 1000 Dire Weeds/Plants -> Dragonfly v1 (L) BP; 1000 Tide Claws -> Enkidd Howler S.4 BP.
1000 Paneleon -> Imperium Detectonator X2 (L) BP; 1000 Swamp Lurkers -> O.S. F.A.P. M1 (L) BP.
1000 Crystal Pede -> Ripper Hide Armor Plate (L) BP.

cost.text: Ammo/decay for 5000 low-level kills.

score.rationale: Needed for Prestige; targets are low-level.

warnings: CyreneDream page last edited over 18 months ago; not re-confirmed by a newer source.

activities.title: Ultimate Noob Challenge and Test of Faith
activities.summary: A long kill-count chain: 15,000 low-maturity kills at Atlas, then five Test of Faith stages (20,000 to 60,000 kills of any Cyrene creature) that each give a piece of Turrelia clothing.
steps: Talk to Jon George at the Rookie Training teleporter, then the A.R.C. Recruitment Officer at Atlas.
Kill 15,000 Weak/Watcher/Soldier maturity creatures at Atlas Hunting Grounds for Pilot Pistol Rank 1 (L).
Then Turellia Tailor's Test of Faith: 20k, 30k, 40k, 50k, 60k kills on Cyrene for pants, jacket, boots, goggles and coat.
rewards: Turrelia pants, jacket, boots, goggles, coat (M/F)

cost.text: Huge kill count (215,000 total); cost depends on your weapon efficiency.

score.rationale: Runs in the background of normal hunting; cosmetic rewards.

warnings: CyreneDream page last edited over 18 months ago; not re-confirmed by a newer source.

activities.title: Salvage and hidden-part hunts (free blueprints)
activities.summary: Exploration missions: find five or seven hidden parts across the planet and return them for limited blueprints. No combat needed, just travel.
steps: Vehicle Master: Dragonfly, Lancer, P.I.G.V. and Spear parts (5 each) -> vehicle (L) blueprints.
James Williams: weapon parts (Ozpyn Chon BP), clothing pieces (Imperium Common Shirt BP), armor pieces (Ozpyn Cold Armor Plate BP).
Shaman Toa'quak: 7 recipe pieces -> Cyrene Acid Armor Plate (L) blueprint.
Part waypoints are listed on the CyreneDream One Time Missions page.

cost.text: Travel time only.

score.rationale: Free blueprints and a good way to pick up teleporters.

warnings: CyreneDream page last edited over 18 months ago; not re-confirmed by a newer source.

activities.title: Miner's Paradise and Mining Iron Challenges
activities.summary: Mining point ladders. Miner's Paradise counts any deposits and climbs to a repeatable rank 7 worth 302.5 PED of a mining skill; Iron Challenges exist per resource.
steps: Miner's Paradise at Mine-R-4900-Bot: 100, 500, 1000, 10,000, 30,000, 60,000 points (ranks 3-6 pay 3, 30, 90, 180 PED of Prospecting or Mining).
Rank 7 (repeatable): 100,000 points for 302.5 PED of a chosen mining skill.
Iron Challenges: two bots near A.R.C. Staging give per-resource ladders (e.g. Blue Crystal, Zorn Star, Lysterium).
rewards: Mining skill rewards up to 302.5 PED per rank-7 repeat

cost.text: Normal mining cost; points come from found deposits.

cooldown.resetNote: Ranks are one-time; rank 7 repeats but no cooldown is given.

locations.label: Iron Mining Challenger Bot - Prospector
locations.waypoint: [Planet Cyrene, 138847, 77083, 112, Iron Mining Challenger Bot - Prospector]

score.rationale: Big skill payouts for miners who already mine on Cyrene.

warnings: In Oct 2025 a player reported Iron Challenge NPCs not giving rank 5+ after rank 4; the Cyrene dev acknowledged it. Not confirmed fixed.
CyreneDream page last edited over 18 months ago; not re-confirmed by a newer source.

activities.title: Zyn Rucksack mining backpack upgrades
activities.summary: A planet-made mining backpack built and upgraded through six versions: Basic, Adjusted, Improved, Modified, Augmented (Oct 2025) and Perfected (June 2026). Each tier mixes hunting, crafting, mining and node-collecting missions.
steps: Basic: enter the Corrupted Laboratory at Zyn'Tukano; trade 10 Zorn Star Ore (male) or 10 Yellow Crystal (female) for a configurator; do Protea'Zyn's hunt, craft and mine missions; collect 100 of each node component for clasps.
Adjusted: same pattern in the 'Deeper Into the Lab' instance.
Modified: Zyn Council missions across Cyrene (June 2025). Augmented: Retired Miner Jorad and J.P.D., mining-focused (Oct 2025).
Perfected: Nulkor, Zelvar and Teskyr at Zyn'Tukano; ore nodes seem to need a surveying level somewhere in 32-50 (CyreneDream guess).

cost.text: Small ore/crystal turn-ins plus mission kills and crafts; Azale'Zyn's blueprint costs 200 Animal Oil Residue and Colorer level 5.

score.rationale: Active 2025-2026 content line for miners.

warnings: Perfected tier node list was still incomplete on CyreneDream (Oct 2026).

activities.title: A.R.C. Prestige (late-game area)
activities.summary: An area on the top floor of A.R.C. HQ opened in April 2025. Entry checks a list of finished missions and achievements, then you buy a keycard with tokens and badges. Inside are repeatable missions found nowhere else, avatar-bound textures, a Golem portal, the Thunderous Golem instance and A.R.C. Tier 4.
steps: Talk to Cait at A.R.C. HQ (top floor) to see which checks you still lack.

Checks: Roy Vulker armor statue mission, Psyche Master Rank 4, H.E.A.R.T. Stage 10, all five Esther blueprint missions, A.R.C. Academy achievement, Rare Cavernous Paneleon find, A.R.C. Commander (Rank 3).
Pay 2000 A.R.C. Faction Badges and 1000 Cyrene Mission Tokens for the keycard.
Inside: talk to Portal Technician Puah, Lieutenant Amos, Lieutenant Sapphira and Requisitions Officer Obed.
rewards: Access to Prestige repeatables, textures, Golem Cavern portal, Thunderous instance, Tier 4 (A.R.C. Adept armor for Shrapnel)
requirementsText: Roy Vulker's full armor set equipped at the statue (pieces drop from r00t, Rhino Beetle, Tide Claw, Zeladoth Nu/XI, Wiles, Muckjaw)
Rare Cavernous Paneleon achievement (hunter's cavern instance)

cost.text: 2000 badges + 1000 tokens, plus all prerequisite chains.

score.rationale: The main end-game hub; costs months of dailies.

activities.title: A.R.C. Prestige repeatable missions
activities.summary: Large kill-point missions inside Prestige that pay chosen skills, plus later additions: Undersea Folken (June 2026) and bi-weekly Mang Chang / Rhino Beetle missions (Sept 2026).
steps: Fangs of Babylon: 100,000 points of Nimet, Venataur or Flesh Ripper (1 PED Avoidance/Xenobiology/Biology).
Judgement of the Serpent: 100,000 points of Whisker Fish, Muckjaw, Skreel or Undersea Folken (0.5 PED).
The Enemy of my Enemy: 100,000 points of Imperium Soldiers (18.3 PED Dexterity/Alertness/Perception).
Putting out the Fires: 100,000 Golem points (3.99 PED); Dec 2025 added Protocore and Vlanwing versions.
Golem Cavern portal: 50 badges for 1 hour. Thunderous Golem weekly: 500 kills for a Thunderous Droplet (needs a Stable or Unstable Assassinator).

cost.text: 100,000 kill points per mission is a big hunting spend.

cooldown.resetNote: CyreneDream lists 24 hours for the skill missions; the Thunderous mission is weekly and Saphira's 2026 missions are bi-weekly per official notes.

locations.label: A.R.C. Prestige Area, 3rd floor A.R.C. Headquarters

score.rationale: Good skill payouts for heavy hunters already doing these mobs.

warnings: Skill amounts for the Protocore and Vlanwing missions are not published.

activities.title: Zorra's HK Epic
activities.summary: A 14-stage story chain from Zorra Winters ending in the Xent Tech Light Rifle Prototype, which can then be refined with rare Lazidol parts into Zorra's HK.
steps: Talk to Zorra Winters at A.R.C. HQ; kill 1002 Imperium Soldiers.
For the High Shaman: 560 Mang Chang tusks, 2800 Paneleon, 1454 Zyn'Dos, 11,000 Merfolken (+ the Merfolken Spearman), 40 Imperium Key Cubes, 512 Skreel.
Refine the six stage items together for the Zyn'Kimbro Enchanted Spear & Lure; Zorra gives the Xent Tech Light Rifle Prototype.
Make a Greater Power Crystal (10 Lesser + 10 Weakened) to get Lazidol lures; collect 10 each of four Lazidol parts and refine with the prototype.

cost.text: Tens of thousands of kills plus rare Lazidol parts (tradeable).
cost.markupNote: Lazidol parts are rare and traded at markup.

activities.limits: Lazidol lure every 6 hours; part trader swaps 3:1 with a 7-day cooldown.

score.rationale: Iconic Cyrene weapon; very long and expensive.

warnings: CyreneDream page last edited Oct 2022.
Zorra's HK owners can now also work toward Zorra's Blessed Laser Amp (L) (see cyrene-limited-amps).

activities.title: Tanhok Ambassador Epic (and Neff's Stim Pack)
activities.summary: Ten big kill stages for the Tanhok Ambassador; refine the ten completion coins with Tanhok Amber into a token that buys a weapon of your choice. Afterwards Senator Neff's follow-up leads to the Empis Wasp Queen and Neff's Stim Pack.
steps: Stages: 10,000 Zeladoth points (Alpha-Kappa), 1500 Merfolken Spearmen, 10,000 Zeladoth points (Lambda+), 2650 Sky Wraiths, 625 Muckjaw, 600 Molten/Lava Golems, 4400 Skull Birds, 1550 Stalkers, 315 Wiles, 2500 Dusters.
Refine all 10 coins with Tanhok Amber (drops from Wiles and r00t) for a Tanhok Tribesman Token; trade it to the Tanhok Trader.
Optional: Senator Calvin Neff's stages 11-12 (Wasp Queen Bait from many materials, then hunt the Queen).

cost.text: Very large hunting spend across mid/high-level mobs.

score.rationale: Strong reward, but a months-long hunting chain.

warnings: Pages last edited 2023-2024; weapon options not listed.

activities.title: The Zyn'viathan Epic (Epic Jellyworm pet)
activities.summary: Ten repeatable parts that each give a tradeable Zyn'viathan Coin. Refining all ten makes The Fabled Genesis Key, traded on Genesis Beach for the Epic Jellyworm pet.
steps: Parts can run in parallel: heal hunters, 40,000 Skull Bird points, 500,000 Renegade Hazard Mech points, craft 'Diamond in the Rough' texture 10,000 times, find 5,000 Olerin claims.
Also: 250,000 Turrelion Zeladoth points at the Rift, 1500 PvP kills, tame 2500 Rhino Beetles, turn in 2500 badges, 320,000 Tide Claw points.
Part 4 needs Psyche Master Rank 4 and the Diamond blueprint (1000 Bone-Out Meat + 2000 badges at Al'bryt Hoizyn).
Refine the 10 coins into the Genesis Key and trade it for the pet.

cost.text: Enormous; 4500 badges in parts 4 and 9 alone.
cost.markupNote: Coins are tradeable, so buying some is an alternative.

currencies.name: A.R.C. Faction Badge
currencies.note: 2500 for part 9, 2000 for the part 4 blueprint.

currencies.name: Zyn'viathan Coin
currencies.note: Tradeable; listed in a better auction category since Oct 2025.

cooldown.resetNote: CyreneDream: 24 hours between turning a part in and picking it up again.

score.rationale: Prestige pet; mainly for dedicated players or coin traders.

warnings: Healing part relies on support tools; support weapons are a known Cyrene issue through Sept 2026.

activities.title: Unstable / Stable Turrelion Assassinator (Cypher of Hyden)
activities.summary: Cyrene's longest chain. Buy a Hub coat with 550,000 Lime Green Tokens, then follow Hyden the Cypher through rifts, 5,000 PvP kills, 60,000 Vibrant Sweat and huge collections for the planet-bound Unstable Turrelion Assassinator. The Stable follow-up unbinds and improves it; 2026 added attachment missions.
steps: Collect 550,000 Lime Green Tokens in the Hub and buy the Coat of the Proving Grounds.
Wear it, talk to Hyden near Kwarn, find the seven rifts with the Turrelia Rift Beacon, then do 5,000 PvP kills (repeatable weekly for skills).
With 900 badges on you, hand in 60,000 Vibrant Sweat; then collect lungs, heart shards, sinew, ears and soulchips; finale needs 1000 Zorn Star Ingots and 10,000 Vibrant Sweat.

Stable chain: Faction Loyalty kills across factions (Imperium need cut to 8,000 in June 2025), several NPC turn-ins; Mar 2026 terminals above Kwarn TP offer Coat, Sight, Scope or Amp attachments (choose one at a time).
rewards: Stable attachment components (marked rare in June 2026)

cost.text: Hundreds of thousands of kills, large sweat and ingot turn-ins; CyreneDream's author reports paying about 450 PED for PvP help.

score.rationale: Top-tier planet weapon; enormous time and PED commitment.

warnings: CyreneDream notes the later stages are partly guesswork from several players.
The lootable PvP teleport NPC was noted as disabled on the UTA page.

activities.title: Zorra's Blessed Laser Amp (L) and Hyden's Unstable BLP Amp (L)
activities.summary: High-level limited amps added Oct 2025 for owners of Zorra's HK or a Turrelion Assassinator. They mix badge turn-ins, a daily mission and item turn-ins; Dec 2025 raised their TT value.
steps: Zorra's HK owners: talk to Rory at A.R.C. HQ; 3000 Male Zeladoth points earn a Token of Zorra's Blessing (14-day cooldown).
Assassinator owners: talk to Frankie near Kwarn TP; 5000 Duster points earn a Token of Hyden's Cunning (24h cooldown).
Hand in the token plus the listed items (including extra Animal Oil Residue since Dec 2025) for the amp.

cost.text: Badges and item turn-ins; exact list shown in-game.

cooldown.resetNote: Hyden token mission 24 hours; Zorra token mission 14 days (CyreneDream).

score.rationale: Only for owners of the epic weapons; renewable amps.

warnings: Prerequisite is either Zorra's HK or a Turrelion Assassinator; the app can only link one, so Zorra's HK is listed.

activities.title: A.R.C. Offensive: Imperium Snow Base event
activities.summary: Cyrene's recurring planet event: a timed instance entered from A.R.C. HQ with Mecha Lupine creatures (level 8-120), tradeable skill pills and droplets. Runs for about a week several times a year.
steps: Watch CyreneDream or the Cyrene Discord for the next date (recent runs include Dec 15-22 2025, Mar 24-31 2026 and Oct 6-13 2026).
Enter from the Snow Base waypoint at A.R.C. HQ (solo or team instance; 6-hour timeout, re-entry allowed during the event).
Hunt Mecha Lupines; pick up zone missions near each teleporter to summon bosses.
Mecha Lupine kills also count for the Stable Assassinator Imperium faction.
rewards: Droplets (5 refine into a Pristine or a Thunderous Gem Shard)

cost.text: Normal hunting cost; creature level 8-120 so pick a matching zone.

cooldown.resetNote: Event windows are announced per run (about a week each, several times a year).

activities.title: Seasonal events: Nightmare Nexus and Jolly Wonderland
activities.summary: Limited-time instances: the Halloween Nightmare Nexus (back in October 2026 per MindArk notes) and the winter Jolly Wonderland. Both add special creatures, textures and cosmetics, and holiday gifts for Cyrene players.
steps: Check the latest MindArk release notes for dates.
Enter the event instance (relog if you leave and want to re-enter the Nightmare Nexus, per CyreneDream 2025).
Do the event hunting and hidden-texture missions; winter sculptures cost 150 Holiday Magic each (2025).
rewards: Event textures, cosmetics, sculptures, holiday gifts

score.rationale: Fun, mostly cosmetic.

activities.title: Free hunter's caverns and sweat-cost instances
activities.summary: Several private instances let you hunt without competition. The Weak Paneleon, Paneleon, Tide Claw, Zeladoth and Rift caverns are free; Flesh Ripper, r00t and Living Storm instances cost 1000 sweat. Team instances hold 12 players since June 2026.
steps: Free: Weak Paneleon Hunter's Cavern, Paneleon / Tide Claw / Zeladoth Hunter's Caverns (A.R.C. HQ), Sky Labs Arret area, The Rift Cavern.
1000 sweat: The Cave of Flesh, A.R.C. Forward Camp - ROOT, Aerithalas.
The hunter's caverns can spawn a rare Cavernous Paneleon (an achievement needed for Prestige).
rewards: Chance at the Rare Cavernous Paneleon achievement

cost.text: Free or 1000 sweat to enter.

score.rationale: Free, quiet hunting for newcomers.

warnings: Instance list last edited Nov 2023.

activities.title: Hidden cosmetic missions and 'Test your Invincibility'
activities.summary: A set of odd free missions that each give a cosmetic piece; holding four of them unlocks a 2025 mission for the Lava Proof Jacket.
steps: No Poaching! (kill one penned Paneleon at Zyn'Tukano from outside the pen) -> tee.
Watch your Step! (teleport rings to a floating island, fall off at the marked spot) -> pants.
Heavy Water... (go under a ruins statue, come back later and swim around it) -> hat.
Steppin' Out (get killed by all five colours of r00t mech) -> shoes.
With all four in inventory, go to the trigger point near 0x101 Supply Depot and do the four 'proof' spots -> Lava Proof Jacket.
rewards: No Poaching Tee, Watch Your Step Pants, Heavy Water Hat, Steppin' Out Shoes, Lava Proof Jacket

cost.text: Free apart from deaths.

score.rationale: Pure cosmetics, but free.
